Taylor (Partnerships): Quick sync - EdgeCloud wants a short co-sell pilot next month. Need checklist: telemetry, billing data, SLA wording, and security signoff. @Evan what billing metrics are must-haves?
Evan (EdgeCloud): We need per-tenant token usage daily, p95 latency by route, and error rates. Prefer a push to our Datadog account.
Jordan (Eng): We can push aggregates (tokens, latencies, errors). No request/response text. We'll emit hashed request IDs for correlation.
Priya (Sales): For pricing we'll propose a 2-week pilot: fixed daily + per-token overage. Partner wants example SOW language for SLA and termination.
Nisha (Security): Confirming telemetry limits: no PII or prompt text. Provide retention and access controls in the DPA appendix. Partners cannot access raw logs on hosted.
Ravi (Partner Ops): Need an on-call point and escalation matrix for the pilot. Can Redwood provide a single PD webhook and 24/7 escalation contact?
Jordan (Eng): Yes, will provide PD webhook and primary/secondary contacts. Also can set alert: error rate >2% for 5m.
Taylor (Partnerships): Action items: Jordan spec + PD webhook, Nisha telemetry appendix, Priya draft SOW/pricing, Evan confirm Datadog account. I'll consolidate into the partner runbook and share the link. Acknowledge here.
